note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Only the supplied route of one participant differs between A and B; no preset states who may attend, any rule, any winner or any outcome. Coordinator decision (standing stress rule, 2026-09-26): the long-labels-stress texts of this paired scene are capped to lengths that fit the 1:1 frame; see that preset's description for the measurements.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long labels, capped under the standing stress rule (coordinator decision 2026-09-26, AUTHORING item 20): every text is strictly longer than the baseline and the count equals the baseline (four people on four separated seats). Measured at 1080x1080 with the near-maximum texts (seat labels ~45 characters, three shared facts, 95-character neutral note) after trying the centre-column, strip-under-scenes (two and three balanced columns) and supplied-seats-only fallbacks: the shared strip leaves the paired plans at k 0.55 (people ~55 px < 60 px) and two seat labels cannot be placed at >= 16 px; with these capped texts every ratio fits (1:1 at 17.7 px, people ~61 px).
